name: 35957 · Boaz, AL
findings: ZIP 35957 (Boaz) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 3 organizations.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
